## Listing of Subjects who Died in Clinical Trials During the Reporting Period



```{r}
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(flextable)
  library(lubridate)
  library(officer)

parse_any_date <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(as.Date(x, origin = "1960-01-01")) # 处理 SAS 纯数字日期
  
  x_chr <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x_chr[x_chr %in% c("", ".", "NA", "NULL")] <- NA_character_
  
  # 尝试解析多种格式：日月年、年月日、月日年
  suppressWarnings(
    parse_date_time(x_chr, orders = c("dmy", "ymd", "mdy", "dmyHM", "ymdHMS")) %>% as.Date()
  )
}

# =====================================================================
# 1. 数据加工 (对应 SAS 的 adaepre 和 pre_final)
# =====================================================================
adae <- read.csv("../data/1002/adae.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if(!"LSTRTEDT" %in% names(adae)) {
  adae$LSTRTEDT <- NA
}
# =====================================================================
# 1. 数据加工
# =====================================================================
pre_final <- adae %>%
  # 先对日期列做一次预处理，确保所有日期列都是标准的 Date 类型
  mutate(
    DTHDT_DATE  = parse_any_date(DTHDT),
    TRTSDT_DATE = parse_any_date(TRTSDT),
    TRTEDT_DATE = parse_any_date(TRTEDT),
    LSTRTEDT_DATE = parse_any_date(LSTRTEDT)
  ) %>%
  
  # --- Step 1: 筛选逻辑 ---
  filter(
    SAFFL %in% c('Y', '是'),
    toupper(AEOUT) == "FATAL",
    # 此时已经全部是标准 Date 类型了，放心比较
    DTHDT_DATE >= as.Date("2025-09-19"),
    DTHDT_DATE <= as.Date("2026-09-18"),
    DTHFL == 'Y'
  ) %>%
  
  # --- Step 2: 变量加工与拼接 ---
  mutate(
    # 1. 处理 TRTEDT：如果 LSTRTEDT 非空则使用 LSTRTEDT，否则用 TRTEDT
    TRTEDT_adj = if_else(!is.na(LSTRTEDT_DATE), LSTRTEDT_DATE, TRTEDT_DATE),
    
    # 2. 日期格式化 (输出为 YYYY-MM-DD)
    TRTSDT_FMT = if_else(!is.na(TRTSDT_DATE), format(TRTSDT_DATE, "%Y-%m-%d"), NA_character_),
    TRTEDT_FMT = if_else(!is.na(TRTEDT_adj), format(TRTEDT_adj, "%Y-%m-%d"), NA_character_),
    DTHDT_FMT  = if_else(!is.na(DTHDT_DATE), format(DTHDT_DATE, "%Y-%m-%d"), NA_character_),
    
    # 3. 计算天数差 (直接用 Date 类型相减)
    STDTC = as.numeric(DTHDT_DATE - TRTSDT_DATE) + 1,
    ENDTC = as.numeric(DTHDT_DATE - TRTEDT_adj) + 1,
    
    # 4. 拼接 TRTDTH (包含换行符 \n)
    TRTDTH = case_when(
      !is.na(STDTC) & !is.na(ENDTC) ~ paste0(STDTC, "/\n", ENDTC),
      !is.na(STDTC) & is.na(ENDTC)  ~ as.character(STDTC),
      is.na(STDTC)  & !is.na(ENDTC) ~ as.character(ENDTC),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # 5. 字符串处理
    RACE_PROP = str_to_title(RACE),
    AEREL_PROP = str_to_title(AEREL),
    SEX_RAW = SEX,
    
    # 6. 处理年龄缺失值
    AGE_STR = if_else(!is.na(AGE) & AGE != "", as.character(AGE), "."),
    
    # 7. 拼接受试者信息 ARM_SUJ
    ARM_SUJ = paste0(SUBJID, "/", TUMORTYP, "/\n", AGE_STR, "/", SEX_RAW, "/", RACE_PROP)
  ) %>%
  
  # --- Step 3: 选择需要的列并排序 ---
  select(
    STUDYID         = STUDYID,
    Subject_Info    = ARM_SUJ,
    Date_First_Dose = TRTSDT_FMT,
    Date_Last_Dose  = TRTEDT_FMT,
    Death_Date      = DTHDT_FMT,
    Days_Since      = TRTDTH,
    SAE_Term        = AETERM,
    Relationship    = AEREL_PROP
  ) %>%
  arrange(STUDYID, Subject_Info, Date_First_Dose, Date_Last_Dose) %>%
  
  # 将 NA 替换为空白
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(is.na(.), "", .)))


# =====================================================================
# 2. 生成并展示 Listing 表格
# =====================================================================
ft <- flextable(pre_final) %>%
  autofit() %>%
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  set_header_labels(
    STUDYID         = "Study ID",
    Subject_Info    = "Subject ID/Indication/\nAge/Gender/Race",
    Date_First_Dose = "Date of First\nDose",
    Date_Last_Dose  = "Date of\nLast Dose",
    Death_Date      = "Death Date",
    Days_Since      = "Days Since First Dose/\nDays Since Last Dose", 
    SAE_Term        = "SAE Term",
    Relationship    = "Relationship to\nJAB-23E73"
  ) %>%
  compose(
    i = 1, j = "Days_Since", part = "header",
    value = as_paragraph(
      "Days Since First Dose", as_sup("a"), "/\n",
      "Days Since Last Dose", as_sup("b")
    )
  ) %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1.5), part = "header") %>%
  hline_bottom(border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1), part = "header") %>%
  hline_bottom(border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 1.5), part = "body") %>%
  align(align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  valign(valign = "top", part = "all") %>%
  width(j = "STUDYID", width = 0.8) %>%
  width(j = "Subject_Info", width = 1.6) %>%
  width(j = "Days_Since", width = 1.3) %>%
  width(j = "SAE_Term", width = 1.5) %>%
  width(j = "Relationship", width = 1.3) %>%
  set_caption("Listing 7 Listing of Subjects who Died in Clinical Trials During the Reporting Period")
ft
```
